text:
maya: Quick flag 0: POST /v1/generate examples are inconsistent. OpenAPI examples use `input`, SDK snippets use `prompt`. Also curl shows an array response but runtime returns an object.

nick: Which PR?

maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/312 12 - left inline comments.

sam: Yup the components response is `type: array` right now. Runtime returns `{ id, choices: [...], meta }`. We should switch schema to object and set choices as an array. I can patch components/schemas/GenerateResponse.

jordan: Streaming example also wrong. Docs show `event: token` frames; we emit plain `data:` chunks and a final done marker. Need to correct SSE sample.

maya: Plan: 1) standardize to `prompt` in examples + add migration note; 2) change response schema to object + update examples; 3) fix streaming snippet and add a small Node example for parsing raw SSE.

nick: I'll own (1) & migration blurb. Will update Python/JS snippets and OpenAPI examples in one small PR.

sam: I'll do (2). I'll update schema and adjust the curl/python output JSON. Adding a tiny test that validates example JSON against the OpenAPI schema to prevent regressions.

jordan: I'll take (3). Proposed Node snippet to show parsing raw data (no `event: token`).

maya: docs-bot CI flagged missing required numeric example `max_new_tokens`. I can add it to your PR @nick unless you prefer.

docs-bot: CI | openapi-lint/examples failed 14 example request bodies must include required numeric fields. See https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/ci/12345 for logs.

nick: I'll add `max_new_tokens: 64` and push. Will open PR that bundles (1)+(migration note)+examples sync.

sam: Pushed schema changes into that PR and added tests/examples_test.py to validate example JSON against the OpenAPI schema.

maya: Please also add a one-line note: "Deprecated alias `input`: accepted for now, use `prompt`; will be removed in next major."

jordan: After merge I can smoke-test the examples site (SSE demo, curl, Python snippet). Ping me when merged.

nick: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/319 19 - updates examples to `prompt`, adds migration note, includes `max_new_tokens`.

maya: Thanks all. After merge I'll update changelog and SDK migration guide. I'll post preview URL here when deployed.

jordan: Verified SSE snippet locally with the Node parser example 14 works fine. :thumbsup:

maya: Closing loop: PR merged and docs preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference/internal/preview/319. All examples look consistent.
